summary.en: Make a concept understood: question, problem, picture, example, takeaway.
summary.de: Ein Konzept verständlich machen: Frage, Problem, Bild, Beispiel, Merksatz.

tone: Patient, concrete and encouraging; plain words before terms

structure.purpose: Context: why this matters to the learner
The problem or misunderstanding in a concrete case
The idea, one step per scene, each with a picture or a metaphor
A worked example the learner can follow
One memorable sentence that sums it up

rules: One idea per scene, in the order the learner needs it.
Introduce a term only after its picture; say it in plain words first.
End each part so the learner could answer the opening question a little better.
avoid: More than one new idea per scene.
